title: LogLab — Unreal & Unity Logging Tools
description: Editor-focused logging and diagnostics toolkit for game teams. The Unreal Engine version is live on Fab; the Unity package is nearly ready, bringing the same fast log filtering, warning/error grouping, and developer-friendly console workflow to Unity projects.

title: Unreal Health Dashboard
description: Operational dashboard for Unreal Engine projects that turns build, automation, test, and editor health signals into a readable project status view. Designed to help teams spot regressions, understand pipeline health, and prioritise fixes without digging through scattered logs.
